name: TOC project lifecycle
purpose: Give the next lifecycle stage of a UOR Foundation project from its stage now, the application before the TOC, whether a quorum met, the TOC's recorded vote, whether the stage's evidence is complete and how many days the public comment period ran. Send stage, application, quorum, vote, evidence or comment, separated by spaces; it answers proposed, sandbox, incubation, graduated or archived, and invalid request for anything else.
inputLabel: Request: stage application quorum vote evidence comment

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: UT-01: the app never answers graduated when quorum is unmet and stage is incubation. UT-02: the app never answers graduated when vote is majority and stage is incubation. UT-03: the app never answers graduated when comment is below 14 and stage is incubation. UT-04: the app never answers incubation when stage is proposed. UT-05: the app never answers graduated when stage is sandbox. UT-06: the app never answers sandbox when evidence is partial and stage is proposed. UT-07: the app always answers graduated when stage is graduated and application is not archival. UT-08: the app always answers archived when stage is archived.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  stage is archived → archived
  stage is proposed and application is sandbox and quorum is met and vote is not none and vote is not rejected and evidence is complete → sandbox
  stage is sandbox and application is incubation and quorum is met and vote is not none and vote is not rejected and evidence is complete → incubation
  stage is incubation and application is graduation and quorum is met and vote is twothirds and evidence is complete and comment is at least 14 → graduated
  stage is not proposed and application is archival and quorum is met and vote is not none and vote is not rejected and evidence is complete → archived
  stage is sandbox → sandbox
  stage is incubation → incubation
  stage is graduated → graduated
  otherwise → proposed
proposition.plain: Give the next lifecycle stage of a UOR Foundation project from its stage now, the application before the TOC, whether a quorum met, the TOC's recorded vote, whether the stage's evidence is complete and how many days the public comment period ran.
